announcements.title: Missing Dog
announcements.description: A resident is looking for his missing brown-and-white dog. The dog has a white chest and muzzle, brown ears and back, and a fluffy tail. If you’ve seen him or know where he might be, please contact the barangay office so the resident can be reunited with his dog.

announcements.title: Black Wallet Found
announcements.description: A black wallet was found along Patria Street at around 1:00 PM. It is currently being kept safe while its owner is being located. If you believe it belongs to you, please contact the barangay office and provide a description of the wallet and its contents to help verify your claim.
